verdict.rationale: Gumloop documents official Python and JavaScript SDKs for building on the platform from your own code, and publishes a first-party gumloop-py GitHub repo. The Python SDK's resource client covers chat completions, agents, sessions, MCP, skills, artifacts, and teams. The JavaScript SDK is described only in terms of starting automations and retrieving outputs. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the SDKs, and evidence that the JavaScript SDK matches the Python SDK's resource coverage.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs
